titles.title: Long Lake, Colorado, Adrienne Brugger sketchbook

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: A brown mountain is in the left side of the paper, with green trees in a forty-five degree angle, starting a quarter of the way down from the top right, and angling down to the bottom left. Blue and white mountains are above the trees. A light blue and white sky is in the space above the mountains.
title: Long Lake, Colorado, Adrienne Brugger sketchbook
